# RaceWax

> > Premium ski and snowboard tuning equipment, waxes, and tools featuring brands like Toko, Swix, and BAF for racers and enthusiasts.

RaceWax is a family-owned business based in Centennial, Colorado, founded in 1999 by Marc & Emelda. The site offers comprehensive tuning solutions from complete kits to individual tools, along with detailed tutorials for both beginners and advanced tuners.

## Key Topics

- Ski tuning and maintenance
- Snowboard waxing and care
- Edge tuning and beveling
- Base repair with P-Tex
- Roto brush systems
- Toko and Swix tools
- ICECUT files
- Universal and racing wax
- Hot wax application
- Base and side bevel angles
- Complete tuning kits
- Diamond stones and polishing
- Sidewall planers
- Temperature-specific waxes
